description: This file defines a custom decision tree implementation in Python, including classes for tree nodes and the tree itself. It provides methods for converting from sklearn's tree structure, pruning, visualization (toDot format), code generation, and prediction logic. The implementation allows for transformations like pruning that are not directly supported by sklearn.

classes.name: DecisionTreeNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the decision tree, storing feature, threshold, child nodes, class probabilities, sample count, and node ID.

classes.name: DecisionTree
classes.description: A custom decision tree class providing API similar to sklearn, with additional methods for pruning, visualization, and code generation.
